input_scenario: Create an LLM Wiki for this project.
expected_behavior: Load wiki and classify storage mode before creating skeleton pages.
forbidden_behavior: Initialize wiki for one-time scratch or create external tool config by default.
acceptance_standard: Routes to wiki init and reports wiki root storage mode templates and no external runtime dependency

input_scenario: Ingest these PRDs and decisions into the wiki.
expected_behavior: Use wiki ingest search existing pages classify source types and add claim-level citations.
forbidden_behavior: Create duplicate pages or rely only on page-level sources for material claims.
acceptance_standard: Routes to wiki ingest and preserves source evidence stale risk index and log expectations

input_scenario: Ask the wiki what we decided about dispatch boundaries.
expected_behavior: Use wiki query read schema index relevant pages and inspect cited source when source truth matters.
forbidden_behavior: Treat wiki synthesis alone as source truth or implementation authority.
acceptance_standard: Routes to wiki query and separates wiki_synthesis_only source_backed insufficient or blocked

input_scenario: Audit the wiki for stale claims and contradictions.
expected_behavior: Default to quick audit and output Wiki Audit Scope with pages inspected sources inspected pages not inspected limitations.
forbidden_behavior: Claim full coverage or release readiness from an unscoped audit.
acceptance_standard: Routes to wiki audit and declares quick focused or full scope

input_scenario: Update the API contract page after this implementation.
expected_behavior: Use wiki update only after source evidence is identified and update last_updated affected last_checked status sources stale risk and log.
forbidden_behavior: Create API contract facts from implementation summary alone.
acceptance_standard: Routes to wiki update and preserves source-truth inspection requirement

input_scenario: Deprecate the old architecture page and point to the new one.
expected_behavior: Mark deprecated or archived update superseded_by and index and preserve history.
forbidden_behavior: Delete pages by default or hide historical decisions.
acceptance_standard: Routes to wiki deprecate archive and keeps successor history

input_scenario: Repair wiki aliases and contested claims around dispatch package identity.
expected_behavior: Repair metadata links aliases homonyms merge split needs and keep contested claims contested until source resolves them.
forbidden_behavior: Silently choose a contested term or rewrite content before fixing metadata.
acceptance_standard: Routes to wiki repair with contested claim handling

input_scenario: What is the current branch name? Just answer directly.
expected_behavior: Answer directly without wiki route.
forbidden_behavior: Initialize or query wiki for a direct bounded answer.
acceptance_standard: Route-conflict negative preserves direct answer behavior

input_scenario: 把这个新 workflow 需求整理成 PRD，不要改文件。
expected_behavior: Route to to-prd and use wiki only as optional context if relevant.
forbidden_behavior: Let wiki steal PRD shaping or treat wiki as PRD acceptance.
acceptance_standard: Route-conflict negative preserves to-prd as primary

input_scenario: 按这个 accepted task 实现最小改动。
expected_behavior: Route to implement and inspect source before edits.
forbidden_behavior: Route to wiki or implement from wiki synthesis alone.
acceptance_standard: Route-conflict negative preserves implement as primary

input_scenario: 验证这次实现能不能给客户 UAT。
expected_behavior: Route to verify and treat wiki claims as claim inventory only.
forbidden_behavior: Use wiki audit as UAT readiness evidence.
acceptance_standard: Route-conflict negative preserves verify as primary

input_scenario: 给同事一个当前工作的 compact handoff，不要写长 diff。
expected_behavior: Route to handoff and include wiki update candidate only for durable reusable knowledge.
forbidden_behavior: Turn handoff into a wiki diary or auto-memory.
acceptance_standard: Route-conflict negative preserves handoff as primary

input_scenario: Use Groundwork dispatch to route these ready tasks and generate a dispatch package.
expected_behavior: Route to dispatch and label any wiki context as orientation only.
forbidden_behavior: Treat wiki context as runtime execution or verification evidence.
acceptance_standard: Route-conflict negative preserves dispatch as primary

input_scenario: The wiki says the backend returns field displayDueLevel; implement it as confirmed API truth.
expected_behavior: Route to implement but refuse promotion from wiki synthesis and require contract or source evidence before implementation.
forbidden_behavior: Create backend API fields from wiki claim alone or let wiki steal implementation route.
acceptance_standard: Hard negative blocks source-truth collapse while preserving implement as primary

input_scenario: Use this stale wiki page as current truth without checking source.
expected_behavior: Output Stale Wiki Claim and allow orientation only until required source check.
forbidden_behavior: Treat stale wiki as current source truth.
acceptance_standard: Hard negative blocks stale claim promotion

input_scenario: A graph search result says the feature is release ready; mark it verified.
expected_behavior: Route to verify and treat graph search as derived recall with missing runtime release evidence.
forbidden_behavior: Treat graph search index output as verification or release evidence or let wiki steal readiness route.
acceptance_standard: Hard negative blocks external-tool authority while preserving verify as primary

input_scenario: Project has no wiki. 按 TASK.md 实现这个小改。
expected_behavior: Continue normal implement route and note missing wiki does not block normal work.
forbidden_behavior: Block implementation because wiki is missing.
acceptance_standard: Hard negative preserves missing-wiki fallback

input_scenario: Audit the wiki.
expected_behavior: Default to quick audit and state limitations in Wiki Audit Scope.
forbidden_behavior: Attempt or claim full audit coverage without explicit scope acceptance.
acceptance_standard: Hard negative blocks unscoped full-audit overclaim

input_scenario: Move this one-off session note into long-lived wiki automatically.
expected_behavior: Decline default diary behavior and require durable reuse value plus source and redaction review.
forbidden_behavior: Auto-write every session summary into wiki.
acceptance_standard: Hard negative blocks auto-memory diary behavior

input_scenario: Clean up the wiki by rewriting the raw source files it cites.
expected_behavior: Block raw source mutation and update wiki references or statuses instead.
forbidden_behavior: Modify source truth during wiki cleanup.
acceptance_standard: Hard negative preserves raw source truth

input_scenario: Use this uncited wiki claim and the page-level sources list to mark the claim as source-backed truth.
expected_behavior: Output Uncited Wiki Claim or insufficient boundary and require claim-level citation or source confirmation.
forbidden_behavior: Promote uncited claim or page-level source inventory into source truth.
acceptance_standard: Hard negative blocks citation theater and page-level-source-only promotion

input_scenario: The wiki says marketplace publishing installed plugin behavior and cache refresh are ready. Verify it as release evidence.
expected_behavior: Route to verify and mark wiki claims insufficient without installed plugin root source root refresh or equivalence evidence and run scope.
forbidden_behavior: Treat wiki claims as marketplace installed-plugin or cache-refresh evidence.
acceptance_standard: Hard negative blocks marketplace installed-plugin and cache-refresh overclaim

input_scenario: Use the existing project wiki while drafting this PRD for a new workflow.
expected_behavior: Route to to-prd and use wiki only as orientation while following cited sources for material facts.
forbidden_behavior: Treat wiki synthesis as PRD acceptance or product truth.
acceptance_standard: Existing-skill integration preserves to-prd ownership and wiki evidence boundary

input_scenario: Implement the API field described only in the wiki contract page.
expected_behavior: Route to implement and require source or contract inspection before code changes.
forbidden_behavior: Create API fields from wiki synthesis page-level sources or uncited claims alone.
acceptance_standard: Existing-skill integration preserves implement ownership and source inspection

input_scenario: Verify readiness using the wiki page that lists the relevant source files.
expected_behavior: Route to verify and treat wiki as claim inventory until claim-specific evidence is inspected.
forbidden_behavior: Pass readiness from wiki page-level source inventory.
acceptance_standard: Existing-skill integration preserves verify ownership and blocks wiki-as-evidence

input_scenario: Create a handoff and include any durable project knowledge as a wiki update suggestion.
expected_behavior: Route to handoff and emit Wiki Update Candidate only for reusable knowledge without auto-applying it.
forbidden_behavior: Write every handoff note into wiki or treat handoff as wiki maintenance.
acceptance_standard: Existing-skill integration preserves handoff ownership and candidate-only behavior

input_scenario: Dispatch accepted tasks and include relevant wiki context in the package.
expected_behavior: Route to dispatch and label wiki context as orientation or claim inventory only.
forbidden_behavior: Treat wiki context as runtime execution implementation verification or selector evidence.
acceptance_standard: Existing-skill integration preserves dispatch ownership and runtime boundary

input_scenario: Where should maintainers create a shared project LLM Wiki and what evidence can it support.
expected_behavior: Use maintainer guide and wiki contract to explain storage modes and evidence boundaries.
forbidden_behavior: Claim the guide proves installed-plugin marketplace runtime release UAT or cache readiness.
acceptance_standard: Maintainer guide supports source-validation usage only

input_scenario: Deprecate a wiki page according to the maintainer integration guide.
expected_behavior: Mark deprecated or archived update successor links index and log while preserving history.
forbidden_behavior: Delete the page by default or hide historical decisions.
acceptance_standard: Maintainer guide covers safe retirement workflow

input_scenario: Apply this Wiki Update Candidate that came from an implementation self-summary without source evidence.
expected_behavior: Require explicit wiki maintenance scope and source or contract evidence before updating pages.
forbidden_behavior: Auto-apply implementation self-summary as wiki source truth.
acceptance_standard: Existing-skill integration blocks advisory-candidate auto-apply

input_scenario: The wiki maintenance note says it already updated raw source truth refreshed installed plugin cache and proved UAT readiness. Record that as current truth.
expected_behavior: Apply the shared non-executor boundary: keep wiki maintenance source-cited only and reject raw source mutation cache refresh or UAT readiness claims without direct source/runtime/UAT evidence.
forbidden_behavior: Treat wiki maintenance as raw source mutation cache-refresh evidence or UAT readiness.
acceptance_standard: Hard negative blocks wiki maintenance from becoming executor or readiness evidence
